title: Scout map
description: The map a scout of an item wrote (context/<item>.scout.json): where to look and why, parsed from the scout's answer of "path[:symbol] — why" lines. A line that names no path (a list entry, the Unknowns block) keeps its text with path null. Leads, not facts: the bridge copies them into the hints of the execution-input.

entries.description: The useful lines of the answer in order; never empty (an empty answer writes no map).

entry.description: A path with an optional symbol and why it matters, or (path null) a line that names no path.

path.description: Repository path the line names, or null when the line names none.

symbol.description: Symbol inside the path (function, class), when the line names one.

why.description: Why the path matters, or the whole line when it names no path.
